name: obsidian-painter
description: Desmos, archify and pandoc for Obsidian; the logic is Rust (crates/obsidian-painter) compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.wasm: cargo build -p obsidian-painter --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && mkdir -p build && cp ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/obsidian_painter.wasm build/painter.wasm
